A '''hospice''' was located on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[400,324 Henryson]] in the [[Sil'Lume asteroid belt]]. It was a collection of white [[plasfoam]] bubbles connected by flexi-corridors, anchored to the asteroid's surface due to weak [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]]. The facility was operated by a beetle-like [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoid]] hive who produced the [[Protein/Legends|protein]] concentrates for the hospice cafe themselves.
